notes: True homograph of H8567 (תָּנָה, "recount") -- same consonants and identical vocalization, genuinely unrelated meanings. Both new in this same batch, so neither needs a retroactive rename: assigned תנה¹ (lower Strong's number) and תנה² per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention.
Both requested stems come from the same short passage (Hos.8.9-10), a deliberate qal/hiphil pairing in the text itself.
